summary: ACP Holdings Acquisition Corp. (Nasdaq: ACGCU/ACGC/ACGCW), a Cayman blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing a September 15, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with May Mobility, Inc., an autonomous-vehicle developer, via merger sub Maestro Merger Sub, Inc. ACP will domesticate to Delaware before closing, targeted on or before May 26, 2027 (Outside Date), subject to ACP shareholder and May Mobility stockholder approvals and customary conditions. Both boards unanimously approved; no price-per-share, premium or advisor was disclosed. Watch redemption levels, Nasdaq listing requirements, PIPE funding and regulatory clearance risk as the de-SPAC timeline runs.
